add.event: 麦道夫之子告知当局父亲承认资产管理业务是庞氏骗局
add.evidence: On December 10, 2008, Madoff's sons Mark and Andrew told authorities that their father had confessed to them that the asset management unit of his firm was a massive Ponzi scheme
He was the company's chairman until his arrest on December 11, 2008.

add.event: 麦道夫承认11项联邦重罪
add.evidence: On March 12, 2009, Madoff pleaded guilty to 11 federal felonies

add.event: 麦道夫被判150年监禁（法定最高刑）
add.evidence: On June 29, 2009, Madoff was sentenced to 150 years in prison, the maximum sentence allowed.
